movie_title: Grown-ups buying kids’ toys ⏲️ 6 Minute English
introduction: It's not just kids who like to play with toys – many adults like to buy kids' toys for themselves! P

vocabulary.definition: an adult who likes playing with toys and games intended for children
vocabulary.example: The toy market is growing due to the increasing number of kidults buying toys for themselves.

vocabulary.definition: a toy doll or animal stuffed with a soft cloth filling
vocabulary.example: She collects cute plushies of different animals to decorate her room.

vocabulary.definition: the amount of money one has left to buy things after paying for expenses
vocabulary.example: After paying bills, she uses her disposable income to treat herself to new toys.

vocabulary.definition: the part of an adult's personality that still feels and reacts like a child
vocabulary.example: Engaging in playful activities helps her connect with her inner child and reduce stress.

vocabulary.definition: a number of things, often a large number of things
vocabulary.example: She bought a bunch of plushies from the store to add to her collection.

vocabulary.word: to have time on your hands
vocabulary.definition: to have a lot of free time and nothing to do with it
vocabulary.example: During the lockdown, he found himself with time on his hands and decided to start collecting toys.
